_source: Principality of Stone Codex, Kingdom Mysteries 9999 (First Death special event when the Unknown Saint is not yet unlocked). Triggered once per game on the first Knight death (Rulebook p.64).

event.trigger: first Knight death in the campaign, if the Unknown Saint is not unlocked
event.text: Immediately Incarnate into the Unknown Saint. From now on, whenever a Knight is about to die and is not Devoted to any specific Saint, you may try to Incarnate into the Unknown Saint. To do so, roll a d10. You Incarnate on a "10", and during Incarnation you gain +1 [Power] (as denoted on the special Unknown Saint card). Return to the Delve.

unknownSaint.name: Unknown Saint
unknownSaint.rule: Rulebook p.69: Unknown Saint — roll a natural 10 to Incarnate, no Commandment/Holy Infusion. Incarnation (p.69): when about to die → Chain Break, stand up, discard up to 2 Bane and any Condition cards, move up to 2 + Devotion spaces, perform a Bonus Attack; bonuses until end of your next turn; then lose the Saint card and all Devotion tokens; the Knight does not die.
unknownSaint.roguesPath: After the 9999 event, every Knight not Devoted to a specific Saint may attempt the Unknown Saint Incarnation (d10 = 10) when about to die. Knights whose Knightbook First Death Event then applies (e.g. Fleischritter: +1 Sigh) resolve it on their own first death. [확인: 9999는 캠페인 전체에서 1회, 첫 사망 기사만 자동 Incarnate]
